name: flashteams-mcp
description: Connects Codex to the FlashTeams MCP server with your own FlashTeams sign-in, and adds a skill for working your next task. Optional: the flashteams plugin already gives Codex every FlashTeams tool inside Flash Console.

interface.shortDescription: The FlashTeams MCP server, with your own sign-in
interface.longDescription: Adds the FlashTeams MCP server, which you sign in to with your own FlashTeams account, and a skill for working your next FlashTeams task. Optional when you use Flash Console, whose flashteams command already gives Codex every FlashTeams tool.
defaultPrompt: Use the FlashTeams MCP server to pick up my next task.
